shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the left-hand mark on the horizontal trace on the left with the mark at (1,−4) on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed function has no value at x=0. Right image: The point (1,−4) is excluded while the same input is still defined by f(1)=5.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow marker omits the indicated point and there is no other plotted value at x=0. On the right, the hollow marker excludes its plotted height only. The filled marker vertically aligned with it supplies the actual output at that input.
